r. 4th cl. (-कुथ्यति)
To stink.
r. 9th cl. (कुथ्नाति)

(इ) कुथि r. 1st cl. (कुंथति)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To afflict, to give pain.
3 To be afflicted, to suffer pain.

mf. (-थः-था)
